page_title: MCI 0-4 TOT | Manchester City v Tottenham Hotspur 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 0 - 4 Goal! Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) scores after an assist by Timo Werner that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:4.
90+2' The booking goes to Manuel Akanji (Manchester City).
90+1' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Pape Matar Sarr and he is replaced by Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham).
90' The manager makes a subsitution with Djed Spence (Tottenham) coming on for Destiny Udogie.
89' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. James Maddison will be replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
88' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' Manchester City are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Manchester City win a corner.
87' The possession of the ball – 57:43.
85' The game is interrupted as Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is flagged offside.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.

84' Manchester City show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
80' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is booked for saying more than John Brooks was willing to tolerate.
80' Today's referee John Brooks rightly decides to book Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) for his harsh tackle.

80' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Guglielmo Vicario anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
78' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
77' The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.

77' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
76' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
74' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Jack Grealish (Manchester City) replaces Rico Lewis.
74' Here comes a substitution. Savinho is given a rest as he is replaced by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).

73' Phil Foden (Manchester City) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Guglielmo Vicario was alert and the score remained the same.
72' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
72' Manchester City show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
71' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 16:7.

69' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
68' Savinho (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

67' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Rico Lewis (Manchester City), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
66' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) produced a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Ederson thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
64' A lofted pass finds Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
63' Substitution. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) has come on for Heung-Min Son.
61' Wow, what an escape. Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.

60' Crossbar! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
60' The resulting set piece from Manchester City is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
59' Manchester City restart play with a quick free kick.
57' The shots on goal statistics – 2:5.
55' John Brooks shows the yellow card to Rico Lewis (Manchester City) for a heavy challenge.
52' 0 - 3 Goal Pedro Porro (Tottenham)! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) was put through by Dominic Solanke and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the left side of the net. 0:3.

51' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul. Tottenham will take a free kick near the side line.
50' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

48' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Tottenham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' Pep Guardiola makes a half-time substitution. Nathan Ake comes on in place of John Stones (Manchester City).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' John Brooks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Tottenham take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.

45+1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will take a throw-in.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

45' Manchester City are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
43' Phil Foden (Manchester City) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

42' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
39' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
35' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball has crossed the sideline. Manchester City are taking a throw-in.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester City, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
31' Flag goes up against Savinho (Manchester City) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.

28' Ederson pulls off a great save to deny Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
25' James Maddison (Tottenham) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
24' A pass into the penalty area from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.

22' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
20' 0 - 2 Goal! Heung-Min Son gets to the ball, slips James Maddison (Tottenham) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 0:2.
19' Tottenham fail to score from a corner as Ederson (Manchester City) leaps to collect the ball.

18' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the top right corner is, however superbly saved by Ederson! Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.

16' Ambitious effort from Phil Foden (Manchester City). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Dejan Kulusevski puts a cross into the box and finds James Maddison (Tottenham), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 0:1.

11' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a comfortable save.
10' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dominic Solanke.
8' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is caught offside!
6' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

6' Savinho (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.

5' A pass lands at the feet of Erling Haaland (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
2' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
1' The foul by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by John Brooks.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
John Brooks is the one to supervise the game today.
